segments.name: Automotive Platform
segments.description: Multinational automotive platform connecting consumers and dealers for vehicle buying and selling with marketplace, software, and data solutions.
segments.evidence: CarGurus is a multinational automotive platform helping consumers and dealers confidently buy and sell vehicles.

revenueModel.text: Dealers pay subscription fees, auto manufacturers and brand advertisers pay for advertising, and financing services companies pay for partnerships.
revenueModel.evidence: We derive our revenue from (i) dealer subscription fees, (ii) advertising from auto manufacturers and other brand advertisers, and (iii) partnerships with financing services companies.

changes.text: Beginning in the fourth quarter of 2025, the company transitioned from two reportable segments to a single reportable segment.
changes.evidence: As a result, beginning in the fourth quarter of 2025 we report our financial results as a single reportable segment.
